items.source: Represents an operation upon two operands of the same type, producing a result of the same type as the operands accepting ClientSession. This is a specialization of BiFunction for the case where the operands and the result are all of the same type.
items.translation: 表示对两个相同类型的操作数执行的操作，产生与操作数类型相同的结果，并接收 ClientSession。这是针对操作数和结果均为同一类型的情况，对 BiFunction 的特化。

items.source: T - the type of the operands and result of the operator
items.translation: T - 操作数及运算符结果的类型
克里斯托夫·施特罗布，马克·帕卢赫
